chatBot.title: Ask Shivang
chatBot.initialMessage: Hi! I'm an AI assistant that knows Shivang's work inside-out. Ask me anything about his experience, skills, or projects.
suggestions: What tech stack do you work with?
Tell me about your AI experience
Are you open to new roles?
responses: Great question! I specialize in full-stack AI systems — from LLM orchestration and RAG pipelines to scalable backend APIs and cloud infrastructure. TypeScript and Python are my bread and butter.
I've spent the last few years building AI-powered products at scale — fine-tuning LLMs, building RAG systems, and shipping multi-tenant AI platforms to Fortune 500 clients.
Yes! I'm currently open to senior engineering roles, particularly those intersecting AI and distributed systems. Feel free to reach out via the contact section.
My backend stack is primarily Python (FastAPI, Django) and Node.js, with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka. For infra, I lean on AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
I've led teams of up to 6 engineers, set up on-call rotations, established code review standards, and built observability stacks from scratch.
